name: When Them Demons Cry
storyline:
Police request:
To: Shishibone Police Department.
From: Detective Minoru Kajiwara.
Requesting permission to investigate area near dam construction and junkyard near Hinamizawa village in the context of the case of disappearance of two students from Shishibone-city. Okinomiya police department denied to help or even permit to work in that area, so I request not to report them about this.

Year '57 Shōwa, 25 September. Request approved.
summary: When Them Demons Cry is a single map MBF21 compatible Doom wad, created for the ENDOOM Mapping Contest 2025, themed after the When They Cry series of visual novels.
